description: Start a historical purchase backfill from QuickBooks Online: a durable background import of PurchaseOrder and Bill documents from QBO into Spark's purchasing graph. Seeds suppliers, items, lead times, and vendor terms so forecasting works immediately. USD only; 36-month window. Idempotent — returns the existing run if one is active or completed. Poll progress via get_integration_status (provider 'qbo'). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token with write access.
name: trigger_qbo_purchase_backfill
title: Start QuickBooks Purchase Backfill
